title: Use the reference odds when the reader's odds score worse
summary: Acts on the parked forecast-use request and gives OLY-B-A2-03 a mechanism (queued job 20261030-024659-qkzw, which left no candidate, so nothing is kept or dropped). When recorded scores show the reader's event skill below the reference over at least MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL jobs, the committed three odds are the reference's. The time and cost quantiles and the timeout guard stay. The audience is Sri and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: A criterion judges calibration by the reader's Brier against the reference after the change.
The criteria run tests with and without the override and check the odds actually committed.
fmt, clippy and test criteria are included.
The rule is enforced in code and recorded as the spec mechanism.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (build_reading at ~767 builds the reader Forecast from ReadingOutput, runs check_reading_size on it, then calls scoring::reference), crates/athena-core/src/scoring.rs (history() builds PastJob from latest scores; reference() wraps athena_score::reference_forecast), crates/athena-score/src/lib.rs (aggregate() gives event_skill, None below MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL=10) and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (~951 calls aggregate for `athena status`). No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are untouched. Skill is measured directly with aggregate over the recorded scores, not through a stand-in.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/scoring.rs (history, reference), crates/athena-score/src/lib.rs (aggregate, event_skill, MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL), crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (build_reading) and docs/spec.toml are extended, not recreated.

The new function (a small helper in scoring.rs or reading.rs, called from build_reading after the reference is computed and before the reader forecast is stored) reads the latest scores through Records, calls aggregate, and swaps only p_reading_accepted, p_verification_passes and p_user_intervenes. check_reading_size keeps checking the reader's own wall_time_s, so the guard is unchanged.

A swapped reading notes the override in the forecast's departures text or the basis string so the record shows the odds are the reference's. How scoring then treats a reader whose odds equal the reference's is left as found. One risk: the skill gate reads past reader scores, so after a swap it may stop recovering. The producer should decide whether the raw reader odds are still recorded for scoring and say so in the docs.
Priority is low; the owner is Athena. Out of scope: asking the reader for fewer fields. The reader prompt has 2 tokens of headroom, so prompts are not edited.
Request 20261030-024659-qkzw is addressed by this change: it supplies the missing mechanism and measure, so that queued request no longer applies once the spec is filled.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new unit test (reading.rs or scoring.rs tests) builds records with at least MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL scored jobs where the reader's event skill is negative, and asserts the committed p_reading_accepted, p_verification_passes and p_user_intervenes equal the reference's. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`; the test fails with the override removed.
A second test with positive skill, and one with fewer than MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL jobs, asserts the reader's own odds are kept. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

The existing timeout-guard tests (a_reading_forecasting_more_than_the_producer_timeout_is_refused_with_advice_to_pick_one_deliverable and the verifier variant) still pass, and a test asserts the reader's wall_time_s and cost_usd quantiles are never replaced. Run `cargo test`.

In docs/spec.toml, OLY-B-A2-03 has a mechanism naming the new function in crates/ (no longer "none"), owner Athena kept, and a measure ending in `status: <label>`, where the label is a line `athena status` prints, or `status: not shown` plus the test that shows it. The statement text is unchanged.
CHANGELOG.md gets one entry. The docs state the outcome check: calibration is judged by the reader's Brier against the reference after the change, per class of work. Check with git diff.
records/, athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows and prompt files are not modified (check with git diff --stat). The change adds no refusal rule: expected 0% of newly refused readings.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` pass (standing defaults: tested, verified).

out_of_scope: Removing the odds fields from the reader's output or prompt
Changing the timeout guard (check_reading_size) or replacing the reader's time and cost quantiles
Re-ordering or skipping planning based on the odds
Changes to records/, athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows, or the reader prompt
Changes to the OLY-B-A2-03 statement text or to other spec requirements
departures: The change touches the reading pipeline and the spec, so it is slightly harder than the reference; verification odds are a little lower.
hard_reason: It changes how the reader's committed forecasts are produced in the run pipeline (reading.rs), which the scoring and the timeout guard consume.
